items.note: S1.1 states Lemma lem:scalar-motifs exactly, and its sub-steps follow the proof at 741-765: old scratch cancelled, net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, and three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). The plan never fixes h=100, N or m, and leaves out the neighbour counts and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782).

Follows the paper's invariant: stored array = D_v applied to the logical array, edge D_vD_u^{-1}, a common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network gives D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and route w applies eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, auxiliary roles included.

The plan states the right content: nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, neighbouring triple lines orthogonal, terminal labels, only central 3->4 edges decreasing (each by h), L=Ich, sum Wm-2N+2L, and L/N=100/539, 101/539. The telescoping (1066-1071) is reproduced, but the per-edge residual table (1022-1042), which proves that every edge is comparable and that only centre 3->4 decreases, is only asserted by quoting its conclusion.

Matches the proof at 1156-1171: P_U on gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} on X_a sources; P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U; the only exceptions are the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, so s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0; the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. The shear frames Phi_M and H<-H+D on every role appear in S2.2.2-S2.2.4.

The kernel-per-orthonormal-residual-vector claim, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, C^{⊗m} on every role, and the Z-repair of the 27 inverse factors on X_a->Y_a are all correct. The phase frame C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{wt(P_Ux)})H^{⊗m} is never defined, and the extension to k columns is missing. The core derivation is also missing: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors makes q_V-q_U a sum over the basis, and conjugating by H turns each character into X_v (1232-1257).

Follows the paper's route: L/N<1/2 gives the deficit, so s_b<W_bm and s_c<W_cm, then eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20 give m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. The relative deficits eta_b, eta_c are never defined as (Wm-s)/(Wm), and their exact values are not given.

The lemmas are used and cited: controlled shifts in S2.1.2, cyclic row splitting into W streams in S2.2.1, digit moves in S2.3. No step states either lemma's content, such as the O(V) bounds or the conditions on the offset.

Reproduces the topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination giving A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, linear-cost triangular transforms, and the three-step sequence D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j, which uses one interchange per one of Π, exactly as at 1375-1446.

All steps of the proof are present: cyclic row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} by matrix shear on each edge, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, merging that undoes rho, three shears forming a swap, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum case split, and the depth-first parking schedule.

Follows the proof: top rho digits form a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces costing O(V)sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), binary-to-[q^e] padding, and the one-bit-difference case.

Edge change as a product of C_{v_j}^{eps_j}, conjugation by P_M with the residual basis as the first columns, one child (C^{eps})^{⊗f} per slot, the inverse via (-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c child calls giving C^{⊗e}, H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, and changes of basis by a fixed number of row additions. All match 1835-1940 and 2210-2231.

Reproduces the eight-operation cycles (00 01 10) and (01 10 11), the output (u+c(1-2(u mod 2)),w), packed cyclic shifts, the guard interval and the union bound delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, repair by extraction and radix sort, the top selected bit, and the cost O(V(L^tau+1)).

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows u=Wg+w sent to role w, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). Matches 2286-2448; q_0 is only described as 'the first few chunks'.

S3 states the layer on D<=d chunks in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one truncation of error <√2·2^{-p}, and the sub-steps follow the paper's route (phase network, packed changes of basis, recurrence, guard width, conversion to H_0). The guard bound Delta=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉=o(p) is quoted, but the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E behind it is not given.

Character cancellation through the shift by t/2^{v+1} and no two-torsion, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage, reverse traversal giving F^+B^{-1}, grouping into H then J_E, prefix-slot moves, at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, layer rounds, the monomial split, error accumulation and the operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}. All match the paper.

B_0=2^{4p} evaluations, four products with the established multiplier, separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred-residue extraction with carry, negacyclic wrap, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost. All as in 3236-3367.

Retained LB order, signed-packed pointwise products, opposite transform and scale by M; normalization via F^-(f*g)=M F^-f F^-g; error 2delta+eta+delta scaled by M giving √2 M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p}; cost including log(rp). Matches 3414-3495.

Follows the paper: the cited Gaussian identity and the bound ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2, the normalizations S', J', D' with product 2^{-2alpha^2}, A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, permutations left in the identity, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, linewise error dp^2, and axis exposure costing O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^tau)).
Periodicity of the chirp, comparison of the coefficient of u_k with QF_t, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, RF^+R=F^+, and the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2. Exactly the proof at 3938-3987.

The fixed rationals, the sizes, the prime intervals with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} search are all correct and derived as in 4110-4171. The plan never gives alpha=⌈(12d^2b)^{1/4}⌉ or gamma=2d alpha^2 with the bound gamma<=b/4 that exact recovery uses, and it never states r=2^{Θ(p^{1-eps})}.

Algebra map, bijection on monomials, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_jP_j, updates in order d..1 rotating only the valid interval, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and axis reversal by O(d^2) chunk swaps. Matches the paper.

Well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, computed phases with error <2·2^{-p}, and the twist/convolve/untwist sequence. The error <4h_p per phase product appears in S6.7.1.

Source transform A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma with exact counterpart RF_s and the conjugated opposite; the algorithm Phi, two transforms, pointwise product, F^+, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries; the two occurrences of S explained. The input scaling 2^{-b-2} is implied only through 2^{2b+4}.

All seven table rows with their powers, the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=eps c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa, absorbing powers of log p into p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). Matches the paper.

errors.says: For triple indicator vectors <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, so every triple line is nondegenerate and neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal in the label field of either construction.
errors.paper: The pairing |S∩T|-1 holds only for the bit network's rational form x^T(I-J/9)y on Q^h. The complex network uses F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, where t_T·t_T=1 and neighbours (even intersection) are orthogonal for a different reason. The conclusion is right but the formula is attributed to both constructions.

errors.says: The labels are nested along every edge and orthogonal between neighbouring triples.
errors.paper: Neighbouring triple lines (indicator vectors) are orthogonal; labels are nested along edges, and orthogonality of t_X, t_Y is what permits the inclusion P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^perp. Labels themselves are not described as orthogonal between triples.

errors.says: The complex network satisfies s_c<W_cm 'in the same way', where the method counts N extra ranks from negative source projections.
errors.paper: The complex count has no extra source ranks: s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, unlike s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b. S1.6.2 later states s_c correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the scalar exchange network through frames, labels, the rank budget and the bit interface, then matrix shears, the power-width recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with tau=1-2^{-50}, arbitrary widths, the simultaneous layer, synthetic transforms, resampling with chirp and cancellation, assembly, exact recovery and the margin table, reaching O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out in three places: the network constants h=100, N and m are never fixed; the per-edge residual table behind 'only centre 3->4 decreases' is asserted, not shown; and the phase frames C_U and the weight-additivity argument behind the complex interface are missing.

steps.note: The network mechanism is fully present: the eight-row schedule, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and every scratch wire restored. The plan never fixes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3. It never defines the data pairs indexed by triples of triples, apart from the implicit u_a=t_{a1}⊗t_{a2}⊗t_{a3}. Since part of the required content is missing, the verdict is the conservative one.
A common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network on arrays implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and each edge costs only a change of frame D_vD_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h, are all stated.
P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the exceptions of rank one, as in the paper.
Sum of |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b, both stated with their telescoping justification.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, through P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}, so the network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, nested labels, rank = dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity, rank-a shears costing a interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only gap is at the start (C1): the fixed network's mechanism is there, but its defining parameters h=100, N and m are never set, so the quantities in s<Wm and L/N are used without being defined.
